name: DeleteFromExcelWorksheet
label: Delete Range from Excel Worksheet
description: Deletes a range of cells or a single cell from the specified Excel worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object to delete cells from.

fields.name: DeletionMode
fields.label: Deletion Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to delete cells: Single Cell or Range of Cells.

selectOptions.label: Single Cell
selectOptions.description: Deletes a specific cell by column and row.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the range to delete (letter or number).

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the range to delete (letter or number).

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the range to delete.

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the range to delete.

fields.name: ShiftDirection
fields.label: Shift Direction
fields.description: Specifies how to shift remaining cells after deletion.

selectOptions.label: Up
selectOptions.description: Shifts remaining cells up after deletion.

selectOptions.label: Left
selectOptions.description: Shifts remaining cells left after deletion.
